mapper.delete: DELETE FROM biz_group_user WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_group_user WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND check_result = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_group_user WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND check_result = 1
SELECT * FROM biz_group_user WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND check_result != 0 AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT gu.group_mem_id AS groupMemId, gu.group_id, g.group_name AS groupName, gu.user_id, u.user_nickname AS userName, u.user_avatar, gu.apply_type, gu.apply_remark, gu.check_result, gu.created_time FROM biz_group_user gu LEFT JOIN biz_group g ON gu.group_id = g.group_id LEFT JOIN biz_user u ON gu.user_id = u.sys_user_id WHERE gu.user_id = #{userId} AND gu.apply_type = 0 ORDER BY gu.created_time DESC

SELECT gu.group_mem_id AS groupMemId, gu.user_id, u.user_nickname AS userName, u.user_avatar, gu.apply_remark, gu.created_time FROM biz_group_user gu LEFT JOIN biz_user u ON gu.user_id = u.sys_user_id WHERE gu.group_id = #{groupId} AND gu.check_result = 2 AND gu.apply_type = 0 ORDER BY gu.created_time ASC
